claims: Lucas Oil Products was founded in 1989 by Forrest and Charlotte Lucas.
Lucas Oil Products has key manufacturing in Corydon, Indiana.
As of early 2024, Morgan Lucas is CEO of Lucas Oil Products.
As of early 2024, Katie Lucas is President of Lucas Oil Products.
Lucas Oil Products produces over 270 formulations.
Lucas Oil Products has the title sponsorship of the NHRA Winternationals
